purpose_zh: 把临时边界、社会结果、服务可及性、授权、安全、能源与水文等资料缺口，逐项连接到假设、场景、空间层、指标、发布门、最低证据与资料缺失时的回退动作。它是供专业团队深化研究的审阅清单，不指定真实运营方、审批时点或实施承诺。
purpose_en: This register connects data gaps in provisional geometry, social outcomes, service access, authorization, safety, energy and hydrology to assumptions, scenarios, spatial layers, metrics, release gates, minimum evidence and fallback actions. It is a review checklist for professional deepening, not an operator, approval schedule or implementation commitment.
universal_rule_zh: 只有资料来源、允许用途、范围、时间、版本和专业复核可追溯，才可替换概念输入；空间输入变化先重算几何、指标、图件、HTML、PDF 与 self-check。
universal_rule_en: A concept input can be replaced only when source, permitted use, coverage, time, version and professional review are traceable. Any spatial-input change first triggers recalculation of geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs and self-check.

records.topic_zh: 空间、权属与可逆空间底图
records.release_gate: before any spatially anchored v0.1 or v0.2 research release
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 有明确允许用途的官方或清权 GIS/CAD；坐标参考、覆盖范围、版本/日期、权利边界与现状/控规资料说明。
records.minimum_evidence_en: Official or cleared GIS/CAD with permitted use, coordinate reference, coverage, version/date, rights boundary, and existing-condition/control documentation.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 清权 GIS/CAD · 坐标/范围 · 版本/权利
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 资料保管、规划测绘、权属及相关专业审阅角色；实际主体待依法确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 保留临时几何和低置信度；不作官方红线、权属、法定控制、精确位置或拆改留结论。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep provisional low-confidence geometry; make no official-redline, rights, statutory-control, precise-location, or retain/renovate/demolish conclusion.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 保留临时几何；不作官方红线或法定控制结论
records.figure_fallback_en: Provisional geometry; no official-redline or control claim
records.recalculation_action_zh: 先替换受影响输入并整包重算；不得用局部示意或叙述覆盖面积、线长、比例与节点变化。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张已取得任何官方地块、权属、控规、道路、市政或现状建筑资料。

records.topic_zh: 社区保留与就业转型基线
records.release_gate: v0.1 observation and baseline; no outcome release before consented follow-up
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 经同意且最小必要的家庭/商户与劳动者基线；资格与带薪路径定义；隐私说明、异议通道和预先声明的随访方法。
records.minimum_evidence_en: Consented minimum-necessary household, business and worker baselines; eligibility and paid-pathway definitions; privacy notice, objection channel and predeclared follow-up method.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 经同意基线 · 带薪路径 · 预先声明随访
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 社区观察、就业/教育、隐私与独立评价角色；不指定实际运营方。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 空间支持比例和走廊长度仍可作为概念几何值；居民保留率、岗位转型率、工资或安置效果保持 unknown。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Support-area share and corridor length remain conceptual geometry values; retention, work-transition, wage and placement outcomes remain unknown.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 空间值仍为概念；保留、就业和工资结果为 unknown
records.figure_fallback_en: Concept geometry only; retention and work outcomes stay unknown
records.recalculation_action_zh: 社会结果仅在获授权的基线与随访完成后按公式计算；不得由培训人次、走廊长度或全球暴露率推断。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张已有居民、商户或劳动者资料，不主张回迁、就业、工资或安置结果。

records.topic_zh: 人工通道与无障碍等效性
records.release_gate: v0.1 before any digital-only service migration or public-facing claim
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 服务目录、同等效力的人/电话/纸本替代规则、无障碍走读、可理解性测试和可用性抽测记录。
records.minimum_evidence_en: A service catalogue, equal-status human/phone/paper fallback rules, accessibility walk-through, comprehensibility test and availability spot-check record.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 服务目录 · 同等替代 · 无障碍走读
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 无障碍、公共服务、老年使用者与独立观察角色；实际服务主体待确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 保留人工、电话、纸本与现场说明为概念底线；等效可用率和可及性绩效保持 unknown。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep human, phone, paper and on-site explanation as concept floors; equivalence and accessibility performance remain unknown.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 保留人工/电话/纸本；等效性与可及性为 unknown
records.recalculation_action_zh: 仅在声明服务范围和真实走读资料齐备后计算等效性；不得用网页可访问性或空间面积替代服务可用性。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张任何服务已上线、已通过用户测试或已达到无障碍绩效。

records.topic_zh: 城市 API、公共数据与治理授权
records.topic_en: City API, public data and governance authorization
records.release_gate: v0.2 only after lawful authorization, impact review and human takeover protocol
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 用途限定的授权目录、数据分类与最小权限、影响评估、可核查日志、人工接管、退出与独立评价安排。
records.minimum_evidence_en: Purpose-limited authorization catalogue, data classification and least privilege, impact assessment, auditable logs, human takeover, exit and independent-review arrangements.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 授权目录 · 影响评估 · 日志/接管/退出
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 资料责任、公共管理、隐私/安全、专业审阅与公众观察角色；实际授权主体待确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 只保留模拟、匿名或纸面协议研究；不处理真实敏感数据，不输出调用、治理或绩效结论。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep only simulated, anonymized or paper-protocol research; process no real sensitive data and state no call, governance or performance result.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 仅模拟/匿名/纸面协议；不处理真实敏感数据
records.figure_fallback_en: Simulation/anonymization/paper only; no real sensitive data
records.recalculation_action_zh: 资料授权变化须先更新场景卡、发布门和影响说明；不改变空间指标，除非相应几何也被正式替换。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张已有市政接口、公共数据授权、数字孪生部署或实际治理机构。

records.topic_zh: 人机通行、低空与事故安全
records.topic_en: Human-machine mobility, low-altitude and incident safety
records.release_gate: v0.2 only after traffic, aviation, safety, accessibility, insurance and incident-review conditions are confirmed by authorized parties
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 适用规则与许可路径、风险分级、行人优先与人工停机方案、保险、演练、投诉与事故复盘协议。
records.minimum_evidence_en: Applicable rules and permit path, risk classification, pedestrian-first and human-stop plan, insurance, drills, complaints and incident-review protocol.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 许可路径 · 行人优先/停机 · 保险/演练
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 交通、航空、安全、消防、保险、无障碍与公众观察角色；实际审批主体待确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 所有线位保留为概念服务廊和纸面协议；不进行路权、低空、机器人或事故安全主张。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep every alignment as a conceptual service corridor and paper protocol; make no right-of-way, low-altitude, robot or incident-safety claim.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 仅概念服务廊；不作路权、低空或机器人安全主张
records.figure_fallback_en: Concept corridor only; no right-of-way or robot-safety claim
records.recalculation_action_zh: 任何正式道路/空域/场地条件改变均先改几何并复算线长；无此资料时不得把概念线位转成工程线位。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张自动驾驶、机器人或低空物流获得许可、可行或已部署。

records.topic_en: Compute energy, green power and heat metering
records.release_gate: v0.2 only after the energy/heat evidence package and professional review are available
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 经授权的 IT 负荷、设施与计量边界、绿电凭证、热需求与热网条件、季节性口径和专业审查资料。
records.minimum_evidence_en: Authorized IT load, facility and metering boundary, green-power certificates, heat demand and network conditions, seasonal basis and professional-review material.
records.figure_minimum_zh: IT 负荷 · 计量边界 · 绿电凭证 · 热需求
records.figure_minimum_en: IT load · meter boundary · green certificate · heat demand
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 能源、节能、热力、计量与独立评价角色；实际设施/运营主体待确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 保留政策门槛和审计概念；PUE、绿电占比、余热交付量及任何节能/供热效益保持 unknown。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep policy gates and the audit concept; PUE, green-power share, useful heat delivery and any energy/heating benefit remain unknown.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 保留政策门与审计概念；PUE/绿电/余热为 unknown
records.figure_fallback_en: Policy gate only; PUE/green/heat stay unknown
records.recalculation_action_zh: 运营数据只在明确边界、时间和计量方法后按指标公式计算；不得由政策阈值、空间节点或模型估计替代。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张任何智算中心、绿电比例、余热接入、节能或供热效益已经实现。

records.topic_zh: 小月河水文、蓝线与气候校准
records.topic_en: Xiaoyue River hydrology, blue-line and climate calibration
records.release_gate: v0.2 only after authorized hydrology, blue-line, drainage and calibration review
records.minimum_evidence_zh: 河道/蓝线、地形、排水、历史事件、模型适用范围、校准记录与防洪专业复核资料。
records.minimum_evidence_en: River/blue-line, terrain, drainage and historical-event data; model scope, calibration record and flood-control professional review.
records.figure_minimum_zh: 蓝线 · 排水/事件资料 · 校准模型
records.figure_minimum_en: Blue line · drainage/event data · calibrated model
records.suggested_review_roles_zh: 水务、防洪、排水、景观与独立模型审阅角色；实际管理主体待确认。
records.fallback_if_missing_zh: 海绵线和无屏绿地仅保留为概念蓝绿公共空间；不主张行洪、蓄滞、排水或内涝缓解能力。
records.fallback_if_missing_en: Keep the sponge route and screen-free green only as conceptual blue-green public space; claim no conveyance, storage, drainage or flood-mitigation capacity.
records.figure_fallback_zh: 仅概念蓝绿公共空间；不作行洪、排水或内涝效益主张
records.figure_fallback_en: Concept blue-green only; no flood/drainage performance claim
records.recalculation_action_zh: 若正式蓝线或水文条件改变空间输入，先重算绿地/公共空间几何和图件；模型结果另需校准后才可发表。
records.not_claimed_zh: 不主张小月河行洪通道、海绵设施或 AI 内涝模型已获批准、校准或有效。
